headline: E Ink unveils next-generation Kaleido 4 e-paper
summary: E Ink announced its next-generation Kaleido color e-paper screen technology, offering improved color reproduction and refresh rates over the Kaleido 3 displays used in e-readers from Kobo, PocketBook, Boox and Amazon's Kindle Colorsoft.

claims.statement: E Ink announced the next-generation Kaleido 4 color e-paper screen technology.

sources.quote: E Ink announced the next generation of its Kaleido color e-paper screen technology today, delivering several welcome improvements
E Ink's new Kaleido 4 could inch us closer to the perfect color e-reader

claims.statement: The new display tech offers improved color reproduction and refresh rates.

sources.quote: E Ink's new display tech offers improved color reproduction and refresh rates.

claims.statement: Existing Kaleido 3 displays are used in e-readers and tablets from Kobo, PocketBook and Boox, and a customized version powers Amazon's Kindle Colorsoft.

sources.quote: The company's existing Kaleido 3 displays can be found in e-readers and tablets from companies like Kobo, PocketBook, and Boox, while Amazon's Kindle Colorsoft uses a customized version to improve performance
